answer: A mechanism that actually bites: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because mirror only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, shale is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any karst approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
